package_info.package_versions: All versions of affected Magento e-commerce sites
package_info.why_malicious: The injected JavaScript code is designed to steal payment information from customers by capturing credit card data entered on checkout pages and exfiltrating it to attacker-controlled servers. This constitutes credential theft and data exfiltration, which is highly malicious and illegal.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when user enters payment information on checkout page)
execution_context.file_location: Injected into Magento e-commerce site JavaScript files (e.g., checkout page scripts)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code hooks into the checkout form submission, collects credit card data from input fields, and sends it via HTTPS POST to an attacker-controlled domain, resulting in payment data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Intercepting sensitive payment data and sending it to an external server is a classic sign of a credit card skimmer.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate checkout scripts should only transmit payment data to trusted payment processors, not to unknown external domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Form validation or integration with legitimate payment gateways may access these fields, but never exfiltrate to untrusted domains.
key_indicators: Reads credit card fields directly from DOM
Sends data to external, non-payment domain

attack_chain.action: Attacker injects malicious JavaScript into Magento site checkout page.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code executes in user browsers during checkout.

attack_chain.action: Malicious JavaScript captures credit card data as users submit payment forms.
attack_chain.leads_to: Sensitive payment data is collected in the browser.

attack_chain.action: Captured credit card data is exfiltrated to attacker-controlled server via HTTPS POST.

behavioral_signatures: JavaScript code hooking into checkout or payment form submission
Collection of credit card fields (number, expiry, cvv) in client-side scripts
Outbound network requests to untrusted or non-payment domains from checkout pages
file_indicators: Unexpected or recently modified JavaScript files in Magento theme or plugin directories
Inline scripts on checkout pages referencing unknown external domains
network_indicators: HTTPS POST requests from client browsers to domains not associated with legitimate payment processors
Unusual traffic patterns from checkout pages to new or suspicious domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for JavaScript code on checkout pages that accesses credit card input fields and sends data to external domains. Use web application firewalls to block outbound requests to untrusted domains from e-commerce pages. Regularly scan site files for unauthorized modifications and monitor network logs for suspicious POST requests originating from checkout pages.
